hooks.text: 从零基础一路学习平假名和汉字，还能导入自定义词表并重练上局答错词汇
hooks.excerpt: Learn Japanese just by playing. No previous knowledge required. Start with the basics and work your way up to advanced. You can learn both Hiragana AND Kanji. Bring your own word lists and study any vocabulary you like. Game over? Start again using the words you missed last time using the "Practice these words" feature.

hooks.text: 掌握系统跳过已会词并反复呈现错词，熟练后自动补全答案让构筑连锁接管流程
hooks.excerpt: The Mastery system ensures that you don't repeat known words, while incorrect words are repeated until they stick. Words which are Mastered have their answers auto-completed.

hooks.text: 在妖怪持续袭击的居酒屋维持顾客满意度，以遗物与灵技协同规划每晚经营
hooks.excerpt: Manage customer satisfaction against unending yokai attacks. Every choice matters - from game changing Relics with unexpected synergies, to Spirit Techniques with run-defining strategies, you'll need to think ahead to keep the izakaya open for the next night.
